definitions.gloss: preferred date; date one wishes (for delivery, an appointment, a reservation, etc.)
definitions.explanation: The date that a customer or applicant wishes to be selected — for a delivery, hospital visit, hotel reservation, interview, viewing, or service appointment. Standard label on Japanese order forms, booking sites, and request emails.

examples.japanese: {希望日|きぼうび}を{選|えら}ぶ。
{配達|はいたつ}の{希望日|きぼうび}を{入力|にゅうりょく}してください。
examples.english: Please enter your preferred delivery date.

examples.japanese: {希望日|きぼうび}が{予約|よやく}で{埋|う}まっている{場合|ばあい}は、{別|べつ}の{日|ひ}を{提案|ていあん}してくれる。
examples.english: If your preferred date is fully booked, they will suggest another day.

examples.japanese: {面接|めんせつ}の{希望日|きぼうび}を{第三|だいさん}{希望|きぼう}まで{記入|きにゅう}し、メールで{送|おく}ってください。
examples.english: Please write down your preferred interview dates up to a third choice, and send them by email.

notes:
{希望日|きぼうび} is the standard label on Japanese forms and order pages for "preferred date."

FORMATION:
- {希望|きぼう} ("wish, hope, request") + {日|び} ("day, date") → {希望日|きぼうび}
- The {日|ひ} kanji voices to {び} in this compound (rendaku).

TYPICAL CONTEXTS:
- {配達|はいたつ}{希望日|きぼうび}: preferred delivery date (online shopping)
- {予約|よやく}{希望日|きぼうび}: preferred reservation date (hotels, restaurants, clinics)
- {面接|めんせつ}{希望日|きぼうび}: preferred interview date (job applications)
- {見学|けんがく}{希望日|きぼうび}: preferred date for a tour / visit
- {利用|りよう}{希望日|きぼうび}: preferred date of use

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {希望日|きぼうび}を{選|えら}ぶ / {指定|してい}する: to choose / specify a preferred date
- {希望日|きぼうび}を{入力|にゅうりょく}する: to enter a preferred date (on a form)
- {希望日|きぼうび}を{記入|きにゅう}する: to fill in a preferred date
- {第一|だいいち}{希望日|きぼうび} / {第二|だいに}{希望日|きぼうび}: first / second choice of date
- {希望日|きぼうび}が{合|あ}わない: the requested date doesn't work

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- {希望|きぼう}{時間|じかん}: preferred time
- {希望|きぼう}{時間帯|じかんたい}: preferred time slot (for delivery, etc.)
- {予約日|よやくび}: reserved date (the date that has been confirmed)
- {予定日|よていび}: scheduled date — the date that is on the calendar; can be the planned execution date or a target date
- {指定日|していび}: designated / specified date — slightly more formal; the date one has explicitly designated

USAGE NOTES:
- On Japanese e-commerce sites, the field for preferred delivery date is almost always labeled {配達|はいたつ}{希望日|きぼうび} or お{届|とど}け{希望日|きぼうび}.
- For polite written requests in business email, you will frequently see {ご{希望|きぼう}の{日時|にちじ}} ("the date and time of your choice") as a more formal phrasing covering both date and time.
